title: OpenCode agent frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of .agents/agents/<name>.md, generated from .claude/agents by sync-agents-mirror.mjs (never edited by hand). The markdown body is the agent's system prompt. Tool allow-lists become an OpenCode permission map; x-maxwell is copied verbatim

examples.description: Static probe of Terraform, Pulumi, Helm and Kubernetes manifests in a target application's repos. Use for probe-iac and probe-app-chart to find misconfigurations mapped to SEBI CSCRF, RBI Directions 2026 and CIS benchmarks. Read-only: never applies changes

description.description: When to delegate to this agent and what it returns; copied from the Claude Code agent

mode.description: primary agents are user-selectable, subagents are only invoked by other agents, all means both. Mirrored Maxwell agents are always subagent

model.description: Model in provider/model form, mapped from the Claude Code alias by the mirror script

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; probes and auditors use 0 for reproducibility

permission.description: OpenCode tool name to allow/deny/ask; bash, edit and skill may map command or path patterns to actions instead. Same shape as the opencode.json permission map

disable.description: When true the agent is hidden and cannot be invoked

x-maxwell.description: Maxwell metadata copied from the canonical Claude Code agent
